title: Scanning an Encoded Configuration
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols, let $x$ be a finite Boolean input, let $s\in\mathbb N$, and let $C$ be a configuration of $N$ on input $x$. Scanning the prefix of the encoded configuration word consisting of its $2s+1$ cell blocks yields the same verifier state as starting from the initial verifier state and processing, in order, the cells indexed by $0,1,\ldots,2s$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols
A configuration $C$ of the machine on input $x$
